name: ltx-video-l0
description: LTX-Video L0 representative at reduced spatial size and frame count with model-card-style denoising
test_prompt: A cheerful small red robot with glossy metal panels walks through a sunlit botanical garden filled with colorful flowers, butterflies, and soft golden light. Smooth cinematic camera movement, detailed textures, vibrant colors, shallow depth of field, high quality.
notes: PR L0 repro for LTX-Video. Uses the same checkpoint, T5 text encoder, LTX DiT denoiser, VAE decoder, native TRT runtime, runner, comparator, and video artifact contract. L0 keeps the 256x256, nine-frame CI shape but uses 30 denoising steps and a detailed English prompt matching the model card guidance; broader quality coverage can use the model default resolution and frame count.
